cues.zh: 这让人挺沮丧的。如果我们的职责是执行政府政策，
cues.en: Makes you rather downcast. If it's our job to carry out government policies,

cues.zh: 那我们不该相信这些政策吗？这想法真离谱。为什么？Bernard，
cues.en: shouldn't we believe in them? What an extraordinary idea. Why? Bernard,

cues.zh: 过去三十年我服务过十一届政府。要是我信过他们所有
cues.en: I have served eleven governments in the past thirty years. If I had believed in all

cues.zh: 的政策，我就会一边热切地主张不加入共同市场，
cues.en: their policies, I would have been passionately committed to keeping out of the Common Market,

cues.zh: 一边又热切地主张加入。我会坚信国有化钢铁是正确的，
cues.en: and passionately committed to going into it. I would have been utterly convinced of the rightness

cues.zh: 然后又坚信私有化和再国有化是对的。在死刑问题上，
cues.en: of nationalising steel. And of denationalising it and renationalising it. On capital punishment,

cues.zh: 我会既是狂热的保留派又是坚决的废除派。我会是
cues.en: I'd have been a fervent retentionist and an ardent abolitionist. I would've been

cues.zh: 凯恩斯主义者又是弗里德曼主义者，既 preserved 又摧毁文法学校，既是国有化狂人
cues.en: a Keynesian and a Friedmanite, a grammar school preserver and destroyer, a nationalisation freak

cues.zh: 又是私有化疯子；但最重要的是，我会是个十足、瞪眼、发狂的精神分裂症患者。
cues.en: and a privatisation maniac; but above all, I would have been a stark, staring, raving schizophrenic.
